verdict.rationale: PostHog's data warehouse docs explicitly describe syncing external sources (Stripe, Postgres, Salesforce, HubSpot, etc.) and querying them alongside events/persons/sessions in one SQL query, plus the CDP pipeline can filter/reshape and send events out to destinations in realtime or on schedule. This covers both directions: querying warehouse tables in-product and exporting events out continuously. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of the warehouse sync working at scale, and explicit named export destinations (e.g. S3, BigQuery, Snowflake) beyond generic CDP description.
